title: Metronome
description: A pixel metronome: a BPM setting from 40 to 200 with plus and minus buttons, Start and Stop, a beat counter that advances on each tick, and a flashing beat light.

title: Expense splitter
description: A pixel expense splitter: add expenses with who paid and the amount for 3 friends, show each person's total paid and how much each owes or is owed so everyone pays the same.

title: Reaction test
description: A pixel reaction-time test: press Start, wait for the box to turn green after a random delay, click it to see your time in milliseconds; clicking too early shows 'Too soon!'. Keep the best time.

title: Pixel painter
description: A pixel painter: a 16x16 grid of cells, a palette of 6 colors, click a cell to paint it with the selected color, an eraser, a Clear button and a count of painted cells.

title: Number guess
description: A pixel number-guessing game: the computer picks 1 to 100, the player types a guess and gets 'Too high', 'Too low' or 'Correct!', the number of guesses is shown, and New game starts over.

title: Task timer
description: A pixel task list with timers: add a task, each task has its own Start/Stop button and shows the time spent as mm:ss, only one task can run at a time, and tasks can be removed.

title: Loan calculator
description: A pixel loan calculator: loan amount, yearly interest rate in percent and years, show the monthly payment to two decimals, the total paid and the total interest.

title: Simon says
description: A pixel Simon game with 4 colored pads: the game shows a growing sequence, the player repeats it by clicking pads, show the current level, and a wrong click shows 'Game over' with a Restart button.
